product_summary: V-Guard Industries (Kochi, Kerala; listed on NSE/BSE) is a multi-line electrical/consumer-durables manufacturer. Its publicly known product lines are: voltage stabilizers (domestic and industrial), electric water heaters/geysers, electric motors and monoblock/submersible pumps, ceiling/wall/table fans, PVC-insulated house wire and cables, UPS/inverters and batteries, solar water heaters and solar power systems, switchgear/MCB distribution boards, and small kitchen appliances. NOTE ON EVIDENCE: during this run the company site (vguard.in) returned HTTP 403 to every request, Wikipedia returned 429, IndiaMART 429 and the search backend was unreachable, so no page of the catalogue could be read directly. The product list above is therefore stated from general public knowledge of the company and is NOT corroborated by a page read in this session, and no customs line was available to me (out of scope per role). Treat every line as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' until a catalogue page or a customs record is attached.
comment: Declared HS 853810 = 'Boards, panels, consoles, desks, cabinets and other bases, equipped with two or more apparatus of heading 8535/8536, for electric control or the distribution of electricity, incl. those incorporating instruments of Ch.90, other than switching apparatus of 8537'. That is a parts-of-switchgear/control-panel code. V-Guard's actual output is finished consumer and industrial electrical goods, not control-panel bases, so the declared code is a wrong/over-narrow fit for the bulk of the range: match_status = partial (a small switchgear/distribution-board line can legitimately sit in 8537/8538, but the declared 853810 does not describe stabilizers, pumps, geysers, fans or wire). Correct mapping by product line: voltage stabilizers and automatic voltage regulators -> 8504 (8504.31/8504.40 static converters; servo/relay stabilizers are classified as static converters, not 8538); UPS/inverters -> 8504.40; switchgear, MCBs, RCCBs, sockets, switches -> 8536; distribution boards/assemblies -> 8537 (and 8538 only for loose parts); electric water heaters/geysers and immersion rods -> 8516 (8516.10); electric motors -> 8501; monoblock/submersible pumps -> 8413 (8413.70/8413.81); fans -> 8414 (8414.51); PVC house wire and cables -> 8544 (8544.49); solar water heaters -> 8419 (8419.19) and solar modules -> 8541.43; kitchen appliances -> 8509/8516. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: this is electrical equipment / consumer durables / building-electricals, not IT hardware. Trader signs: none found — the company is a manufacturer with its own plants (Units 1-3 appear in the name variants, consistent with a multi-unit manufacturer), so role = manufacturer; the many name variants (M/S, unit numbers, punctuation) are the same legal entity and should be merged under one record. Product lines missing from the declaration: stabilizers/AVR, pumps, water heaters, fans, wire & cable, UPS/batteries, solar, kitchen appliances — i.e. essentially the whole revenue range. Per project rule 3 this HS mismatch is NOT a ground for rejection: keep the company, correct the code to the actual line(s) and record the verdict as accepted_hs_corrected. No revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN or shipment data is asserted here (out of scope and not public in this session).
